title: SQL Server: TRUNCATE on a change-tracking table fails the update

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27

symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_UNTRACEABLE_TABLE_MODIFICATION: the update FAILED after a TRUNCATE and five inserts, and no new rows arrived.
cause: The protective check: change tracking can't follow the modification.
effect: Updates stop for that table until it is reloaded.
fix: Full refresh the table; it matched the source (5 rows).
